description: Search the user's owned cards (holdings) with rich filters. Returns holdings with printing data, physical location, per-deck allocations, free (unallocated) quantity, and unit/total price in the requested currency (default USD). color_identity means: card identity must be a SUBSET of the given colors (["G","W"] finds Selesnya-legal cards incl. colorless). allocation filter: allocated | unallocated (free copies exist) | staged | sleeved | shared. name may be in any language Scryfall prints: a holding found by its name in another language carries `matched` (the name as printed, "Foudre"); tell the user it is the English card (Lightning Bolt). Always disclose proxy status (is_proxy) and shared allocations in your summaries. Paginate with limit/offset (default 50, max 200).

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

oracle_text.description: Substring of rules text, e.g. "Search your library"

origin.description: How the card was acquired (mutually exclusive). printed_proxy/bought_proxy force is_proxy=true. is_proxy/is_signed/is_altered are independent flags that combine freely with any origin (a gift proxy = origin "gift" + is_proxy=true).

type.description: Substring of the type line, e.g. "Creature" or "Land"

name: search_collection

shared.description: A shared claim: the same copies are also claimed by another deck. Always say so.

status.description: sleeved: the copies are physically in the deck; staged: still where they were

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

is_proxy.description: A proxy is not a real card: always say so, and it counts as zero in value

matched.description: The name in another language the search found it by

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

total_cards.description: Copies in those stacks, all pages

total_holdings.description: Stacks matching the filters, all pages

title: Search collection
